feature_main_detail: Messages go to the main chat (/new, /list to switch), and replies come back to Lark
feature_cards_detail: When Persona or an agent you drive from Lark needs an answer or approval, it sends a card in Lark. One tap does it.
feature_all_cards_detail: Questions and approvals from every agent on all your computers go to Lark
feature_pushes_detail: Persona's notifications and scheduled task results also go to Lark
feature_sync_detail: Replies in the main chat from the app or scheduled tasks also go to Lark
feature_reports_detail: When tasks from the main chat finish, wait for you or get cut off, one card sums them up in Lark, with stages and links
feature_board_detail: /tasks sends one card listing everything waiting for you, then keeps it up to date in place instead of sending a new one
feature_workbench_detail: /home brings up a pinned home card of everything going on (kept the only one and up to date), every card gets a button back to it, /today and /inbox show the day and the Inbox, and /start asks for a permission mode
feature_only_conclusions_detail: Tasks from the main chat no longer send their progress (a finished turn, waiting for you, interrupted), which stays in the to-do list and the briefing; a conclusion card still comes when there is one: done, can't be done, or needs your decision
feature_report_steps_detail: By default a task is pushed only when its goal changes: reached, needs your decision, or stuck. Turn this on for the old card: every agent's finished turn (with the stage bar and what the agent said), interruptions and closings too
feature_agents_detail: Use /agents to pick Claude Code or Codex on any of your computers and chat with it in Lark; /start begins a new one
step_create_app: On the Lark Developer Console, create a custom app and turn on the Bot feature
step_permissions: Under permissions, turn on: read and send direct messages (im:message, im:message:send_as_bot); receive direct messages sent to the bot; upload and download images, files and other attachments in messages. Reading contact names is also worth turning on (contact:user.base:readonly)
step_events: Under Events & callbacks, choose to receive events through a persistent connection, and subscribe to Message received and Card action
step_publish: Publish a version (your company's admin may need to approve it), then enter the App ID and App Secret above
title: Lark bot
footer: Messaging this bot in Lark is talking to Persona. It only answers you once paired, and stays quiet in groups.
larkcli_dialog_footer: Uses your Lark account to bring @mentions, direct chats and document comments into the Inbox.
test_sent: Sent a test message to Lark
create_footer: Scan the code with Lark on your phone and confirm: Persona creates the bot's app and pairs it with you. Nothing to fill in.
create_footer_shared: Scan the code with Lark on your phone and confirm: Persona creates one Lark app for the bot and for reading your Lark, and pairs it with you.
advanced_have_app: Already have a Lark app? Enter its credentials
read_needs_app: Create the app above by scanning first; then you can let Persona read your Lark here.
credentials_from_config: The credentials in manager.json are in use; saving here switches to these.
credentials_secret_note: The App Secret is stored encrypted on the hub and won't be shown again.
pair_hint: Click Pair to get a 6-digit code, then send it to the bot in Lark within 10 minutes.
pair_enable_first: Turn on the Lark bot before pairing.
unpair_confirm: Unpair? The bot will stop answering this Lark account until you pair again.
pair_code_prompt: Send this code to the bot in Lark
features_footer: The main chat can use all your data (Lark, mail, your phone's calendar and location…), and what the bot sends stays in Lark. Anything done on your behalf still asks you first.
howto_footer: The hub opens the persistent connection itself, so it doesn't need a public address.
nudge_detail: A card still unanswered after this long gets one reply under it in Lark (in a group topic it mentions you), outside your quiet hours
source_report_delay_title: Reply timing for the original group
source_report_delay_detail: Wait this long after the result is ready so you can preview it and cancel. Immediately skips the preview.
combined_footer: One Lark app: talk to Persona through the bot, and collect what mentions you into the Inbox with “Collect my Lark messages”.
credentials_shared_note: The bot and “Collect my Lark messages” share this app.
read_more_hint: Choose what to collect into the Inbox
read_off_footer: Off: @mentions and your direct chats are no longer collected; the sign-in and what was collected stay.
feature_answer_new_card_detail: When a run finishes, its answer is sent as a new card at the bottom of the chat, so Lark notifies you, and the progress card folds up. Off: the answer is written into the progress card
feature_topic_cot_detail: Show a topic run's thinking and tool calls in Lark's collapsible agent message, alongside the progress card. Off: keep the process in the card's folded panel
feature_dm_cot_title: Native process in the private chat
feature_dm_cot_detail: Show a private-chat turn's thinking and tool calls in Lark's collapsible agent message, alongside the progress card. Off: keep the process in the card's folded panel
feature_cot_answer_detail: When a turn has a native agent message, write the answer into it and send no progress or answer card. Long answers, stopped or failed turns, and turns without an agent message still use cards
feature_read_group_detail: In a group the bot is in, your own "@bot /read <task>" reads the last 40 messages (or the range you name), with their images and files, as you, then does the task. The answer comes to your private chat with the bot first, with buttons to post it under your message in the group or not. Others' messages never trigger it
feature_read_group_direct_detail: Post a /read answer straight under your message in the group, for everyone there to see, instead of sending it to you first
source_report_full_title: Reply with the complete final answer
source_report_full_detail: Everyone in the original group can see the final answer. When off, the bot sends a short result.
topic_home_hint: Requests from other groups open here. Choosing a home is a separate action.
topic_owner_mention: Only respond when I mention the bot
topic_mention_for: Only respond when I mention the bot — {name}
topic_policy_footer: Applies only to your messages in this group, including settings commands. Other messages are ignored. A group added with this switch on does not become home automatically. Turn it off to restore the usual topic behavior.
step_sync_permissions: For knowledge sync, also approve these user scopes: offline_access, search:message, drive:drive:readonly, drive:drive.metadata:readonly, docx:document:readonly, docs:document.content:read, sheets:spreadsheet:readonly, bitable:app:readonly, wiki:wiki:readonly, wiki:node:retrieve, wiki:space:retrieve, minutes:minutes:readonly, minutes:minutes.transcript:export, im:chat:read, im:chat:readonly, im:message:readonly, im:message.group_msg:get_as_user, im:message.p2p_msg:get_as_user, drive:file:download, contact:user.base:readonly, contact:contact.base:readonly. Publish the permissions, get admin approval if required, then authorize again to add missing permissions. Sender-name repair retries automatically after authorization.
group_access_conflict: Group access was changed somewhere else, so the latest is shown. Make the change again if you still need it.
group_access_footer: Who besides you may @ the bot in a group, and what they may use. Blocked people and groups are refused in every mode.
group_access_mode: Who can ask the bot in groups
group_access_detail_owner_only: Only you can @ the bot in a group. Everyone else is ignored.
group_access_detail_allowlist: Only people you add can @ the bot, and only in groups you allow.
group_access_detail_everyone: Anyone in a group you allow can @ the bot.
group_access_guest_caution: Guests get a separate assistant with none of your data, your tasks or your computers. It can use only the tools you turn on below.
group_access_per_hour_hint: The most questions one group can put to the bot in an hour, from everyone in it.
group_access_groups_footer: The bot answers guests only in these groups. Add a topic group here to allow it.
group_access_people_footer: Only these people can @ the bot in an allowed group.
group_access_requests_footer: People who @ the bot where you have not allowed them. Allow or block them here.
group_access_blocked_footer: Blocked always wins, in every mode.
group_access_tools_footer: Read-only connector tools a guest may use to answer. Tools that change anything are never offered.
group_access_no_tools: No read-only connector tools are installed
